title: DECISION: IPLD test vectors cross-validated against Python dag_cbor oracle
description: test_vectors.rs in core/src/ipld contains four article vectors (TV1-TV4). RAW block CIDs are verified against Python hashlib SHA-256. Root DAG-CBOR CIDs are cross-validated against Python dag_cbor 0.3.3 plus hashlib on a specific date. The test file explicitly documents the oracle version, date, and methodology. These are not roundtrip tests: the encoded bytes are fixed to externally-computed expected CIDs. If any encoding detail changes (field order, CBOR type for Vec<u8>, date format) the test catches it. A future contributor might replace these with roundtrip tests or regenerate the constants from the Rust implementation itself, which would prove nothing.
